Arlberg WellCom

Sankt Anton am Arlberg · restaurant

**Welcome to Arlberg WellCom in Sankt Anton am Arlberg** Discover a unique blend of relaxation and adventure in the heart of the **Alps**. At **Arlberg WellCom**, you’ll find the perfect retreat after a day on the slopes or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Indulge in our **Wellness Oasis**, where you can unwind with a soothing massage, enjoy a refreshing **Sauna** session, or simply relax in our tranquil **Outdoor Pool**. Afterward, recharge with a hearty meal featuring local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or a cozy **Tiroler Gröstl**. Our **WellCom** concept combines top-tier wellness with the vibrant energy of **Sankt Anton am Arlberg**—where world-class skiing meets charming alpine culture. Whether you're seeking serenity or excitement, this is your ideal escape in the **Arlberg** region. **Book your stay now and experience the perfect balance of relaxation and adventure!**
